purpose: Requirements separating SKILL.md responsibilities from script responsibilities, so SKILL.md keeps judgment and dialogue while scripts apply fixed values and deterministic processing.
summary: Background: script-specific detail in SKILL.md burdens AI judgment, yet orchestration must stay in the skill
Purpose: fix operations and values in advance and leave no free semantic choice to the AI at runtime
FNC-001: clean state of SKILL.md, what may remain and what must not be written
FNC-002: classification of script inputs by origin and responsibility
FNC-003: one scene, one fully determined call contract
FNC-004: placement of misuse defenses, script guards first and no prohibition warnings in SKILL.md
FNC-005: measurement-based refactoring judged by review and grep
FNC-006: skill-local wrapper boundary binding fixed values over shared low-level scripts
Non-goals including minimizing wrappers and quantitative targets
tasks: Deciding what logic belongs in a script versus SKILL.md
Designing script arguments and input responsibilities
Reviewing SKILL.md for noise such as exposed flags and prohibition warnings
Invoking inherited skills via the Skill tool
title: REQ-003 SKILL.md と script の責務分離要件
